name: ac3forge
description: Clean-room AC-3 (ATSC A/52), E-AC-3 and AC-4 encoder and decoder with a spatial object layer, in C++23.

matroska.description: Standalone Matroska (.mkv) container writer (iclforge::matroska) - depends on nothing in iclforge::ac3

mp4.description: Standalone MP4/ISOBMFF container writer, plus fMP4/CMAF segmenting and HLS/DASH signaling (iclforge::mp4) - depends on nothing in iclforge::ac3

mpegts.description: Standalone MPEG-2 Transport Stream container writer (iclforge::mpegts) - depends on nothing in iclforge::ac3

capi.description: Stable, minimal C11 API over the AC-3 and E-AC-3 encode/decode core, and over AC-4 when the ac4 feature is also on (iclforge::c) - for bindings and embedding by callers that cannot or do not want to link C++23

ac4.description: AC-4 (ETSI TS 103 190) sync frame and table of contents reader, decoder and encoder (iclforge::ac4, iclforge::ac4dec, iclforge::ac4enc) - depends on nothing in iclforge::ac3

iab.description: Standalone SMPTE ST 2098-2 Immersive Audio Bitstream reader (iclforge::iab) - depends on nothing in iclforge::ac3

iamf.description: Standalone IAMF v1.1 OBU and ISOBMFF writer (iclforge::iamf) - depends on nothing in iclforge::ac3
